reference_doc: Reference scale: MODIS Aqua active-fire detections per UTC day in the AOI. Aqua is the longest single-platform MODIS record with an afternoon overpass, the one the 1.4 day-level ratio was validated against. It is a reference observational scale, not ground truth: MODIS misses small fires and fires under cloud or smoke, and its own errors stay in the target. Aqua's overpass has drifted later since it left the A-Train in 2022; the year-by-year checks show whether that changes the ratios.
equation: F_d = mean over eligible platforms p known on day d of c_p · X_p,d;  c_Aqua = 1,  c_p = Σ_train Aqua / Σ_train p (1.4 day-level ratio, pairwise chronological split)
eligibility_rule: platforms that pass the pairwise 1.4 gate against Aqua Indonesia-wide (instrument-level eligibility), with a ratio fitted on this area's own training days (≥ 180 known overlap days)

bootstrap.rule: Month-block bootstrap: whole calendar months of training days resampled with replacement; 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles.

validation.design: Leave-reference-out: the fused estimate WITHOUT Aqua, with each ratio fitted only on days before the evaluation period, is compared with the observed Aqua totals. Aqua is never an input to its own prediction.
validation.split_rule: chronological hold-out: the last 20% of days with activity and a known Aqua state

activity.rule: High-fire days: held-out days with Aqua total ≥ the training 90th percentile.

rolling_origin.rule: Year Y is predicted without Aqua, from the other platforms with ratios fitted on all known days before 1 January Y; a year needs ≥ 180 earlier Aqua days and ≥ 30 test days.

seasonal.rule: Rolling-origin (out-of-sample) estimates summed by calendar month over every predicted year.

transitions.rule: Σ estimate / Σ Aqua over up to 365 known days before and after a platform's first known day (≥ 60 days each side). 'step' = after / before; a step of 1 means no jump. Uses the production ratios, so it checks discontinuity, not accuracy.

0.5.definition: Per region cell, over held-out days with a known Aqua state: Σ fused estimate without Aqua (training ratios of the AOI) / Σ Aqua detections. The AOI-level result does not make every region accurate; this shows where it holds.

1.0.definition: Per region cell, over held-out days with a known Aqua state: Σ fused estimate without Aqua (training ratios of the AOI) / Σ Aqua detections. The AOI-level result does not make every region accurate; this shows where it holds.

2.0.definition: Per region cell, over held-out days with a known Aqua state: Σ fused estimate without Aqua (training ratios of the AOI) / Σ Aqua detections. The AOI-level result does not make every region accurate; this shows where it holds.
